editorial.blurb: Soul Vibez is a vibrant, beautifully designed Chicago spot where soulful American cuisine and creative cocktails create an unforgettable night out.
editorial.insiderTip: Arrive early—this place fills up quickly—and request a seat at the bar for smooth service and a prime spot to watch the kitchen deliver.

topDishes.note: Lollipop lamb chops in house-made glaze with grilled salmon over garlic mash—phenomenal
Mac & cheese, sweet potatoes, and greens in a crispy egg roll—unexpectedly excellent
